observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: stage performance under theatrical blue lighting
observation.dancers: mixed group of eight dancers, six women and two men
observation.formation_and_space: group arranged in two rows facing away from the audience initially, turning to face forward in a staggered grid
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees and upright body weight
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping and heel-toe strikes synchronized to the heavy beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held bent at elbows with hands swinging loosely by the sides
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, upright and stable
observation.partnering: none, solo dancing in a group formation
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level with quick heel clicks and sharp leg extensions
observation.costume_and_props: matching dark blue button-up shirts, dark bottoms (pants for men, short skirts over tights for women), and white footwear
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and tap sounds due to lower video resolution and acoustic blending

signature_moments.what: dancers face front and begin rapid rhythmic stepping with alternating leg lifts and arm swings
synchronized high leg extensions with sharp heel drops to the beat
final fast stepping sequence leading into a sharp turn away from the audience
